name: mDNS resolver
info:
(prefer 172.16.10.x then 172.16.x.x)

=== UDP mDNS Resolver (IPv4, Subnet-Preferred) ===

PURPOSE
-------
Resolve a driver hostname (e.g. "tender-driver01.local")
to a usable IPv4 address for UDP thruster control.

WHY THIS EXISTS
---------------
mDNS can return:
- Multiple IPv4 addresses (Docker, overlay, extra interfaces)
- IPv6-only addresses (fe80::...)
- Addresses on the wrong subnet

We must:
1) Force IPv4 only
2) Prefer the boat LAN subnet (172.16.10.x)
3) Fall back to any 172.16.x.x if 172.16.10.x not present

RESOLUTION STRATEGY
-------------------
Command performs:

1) getent ahostsv4 <hostname>
2) Select first 172.16.10.x match
3) If none found, select first 172.16.x.x match
4) Output ONLY the chosen IP

This ensures:
- No Docker 172.30.x.x addresses
- No IPv6 addresses
- Deterministic subnet preference

FAILURE HANDLING
----------------
If no matching IPv4 is found:
- No warning spam
- Resolver backs off for 30 seconds
- Existing cached IP (if any) remains untouched

DESIGN PRINCIPLE
----------------
Manifest defines which hostname is correct.
This node ONLY resolves it to an IP.
It does not decide which driver is authoritative.
